paper.title: Causal modelling of gene effects from regulators to programs to traits
paper.method: K562 Perturb-seq regulator-to-program effects integrated with rare-variant trait effects

robustness.program_selection: top programs retained from the migrated paper workflow
robustness.leave_one_out: recorded in the reproduction workflow; must be recomputed for any changed input

limitations: K562 is a haematopoietic cancer cell line and is not a UC tissue model.
The 94/147 extension uses a different hit set from the paper's 43/59 result and is not a paper accuracy replication.
Results are valid only for the cached MCH configuration; other traits require complete re-analysis.
